title: C++: Linked List
description: Implement a singly linked list with insert and print.

steps.title: Linked List Insert
steps.description: Define a Node struct with int data and Node* next. Implement insert_front that inserts at head. Insert 30, 20, 10 and print.
hints: struct Node { int data; Node* next; Node(int d): data(d), next(nullptr) {} };
void insert_front(Node*& head, int val) { head = new Node(val, head); }
